methodology.warning: No final Flow Risk Score is calculated in this version.
principles: PortWatch transit counts are AIS-derived traffic proxies.
PortWatch capacity is not direct physical oil throughput in mb/d.
Calendar 2025 and immediate pre-war February 2026 are compared before selecting the final baseline.
Suspicious zero tanker-capacity values are excluded from valid capacity statistics.
